ev_0005.summary: Figure is a quadrilateral ABCD (sides DA, AB, BC, CD) with an interior point O joined to all four vertices by solid segments OA, OB, OC, OD. Labels A, B, C, D, O are bound by bind_point_labels and consistent with the segment endpoints (all within about 7 px, snapped). O is not on AC (line AC at x=279 gives y about 417, versus O at y=348) and not on DA (line DA at x=279 gives y about 94). No AC or DB segment was detected, so the figure is not a triangle with cevians. A full circle centred at O (about 279.9, 348.2) with radius about 165.6 px was detected; it meets the figure's segments at nine unlabelled points (on AD x2, OD, OB, BC x2, OC, DC, AO), which are treated as candidate intersections. The angle at O between OA and OD is about 94.8 deg, a candidate perpendicular, but no right-angle mark was verified, so no right_angle object is emitted.
